extracted.intended_audience: designers, studios and agencies preparing submissions for the Cannes Lions Design awards
extracted.subtask_description: Guidelines and judging criteria for entries to the Cannes Lions Design category, covering category definitions, eligibility rules, submission requirements, and judging weightings. Intended to inform how to prepare and present creative design work for award consideration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design Lions purpose / expected qualities
rubrics_metrics.description: The Design Lions celebrate visual craftsmanship. The work should demonstrate creative approaches that use visual and strategic design to build strong brand connections, engage audiences, and leave lasting impressions through cohesive, impactful communication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Judging weighting
rubrics_metrics.description: A number of criteria will be considered during judging, weighted as follows: 40% idea; 40% execution; 20% results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entries should emphasize strong idea development and high-quality execution, and provide evidence of results where possible to capture the 20% results weighting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Multiple entry allowance
rubrics_metrics.description: There is no overall limit to how many times the same piece of work can be entered into Design as long as the categories chosen are relevant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Entrants may enter the same work into multiple relevant categories; ensure category relevance to avoid disqualification.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subtitles recommendation for film content
rubrics_metrics.description: Subtitles are highly recommended on all case films, films, demo films and original content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide subtitles to improve accessibility and ensure jurors understand spoken content regardless of audio.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Brand Design — overarching expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: Excellence in visual communication and design that effectively conveys messages across various platforms.

rubrics_metrics.name: A01 Brand/Corporate Identity
rubrics_metrics.description: Creation of a new brand or corporate identity for any product, service or organisation. This can include, but not be limited to, logos, stationery, and other branded materials.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please note this must be for a new brand or corporate identity.

rubrics_metrics.name: A02 Rebrand/Refresh of an Existing Brand
rubrics_metrics.description: Rebrand/refresh of an existing brand identity for any product, service or organisation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please provide examples of the previous branding for comparison.

rubrics_metrics.name: A03 Packaging Design
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrates innovative and effective packaging that enhances the brand experience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Please send physical samples for the jury to experience. Please also provide a demo film of the physical samples for the jury to experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: A04 Product Design — eligibility and scope
rubrics_metrics.description: Design that increases brand value through functional and aesthetic resolution demonstrating brand qualities/product identity across consumer goods and medical products through form, function, usability, aesthetics, problem-solving, production, research and manufacturability.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All work entered into category 'A04. Product Design' must be available for purchase in order to be eligible. The product must have been available for purchase between 06 February 2025 and 09 April 2026. Please send physical samples for the jury to experience. Please also provide a demo film of the physical samples for the jury to experience.

rubrics_metrics.name: A05 Publications & Editorial Design
rubrics_metrics.description: This could include, but not be limited to, magazines, newspapers, brochures or articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Online publications should be entered into A07. Digital Design.

rubrics_metrics.name: A06 Books
rubrics_metrics.description: This could include, but not be limited to, editorial and cover design for printed books.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The submission should indicate whether only the cover or the whole book should be considered/judged. E-books should be entered into A07. Digital Design.

rubrics_metrics.name: A07 Digital Design
rubrics_metrics.description: The execution of design to aid the function and use of the digital product. This may include, but is not limited to, websites, online publications, digital installations, apps, data visualisation, virtual worlds, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Does not include prototypes of early-stage technology. Online publications and e-books should be entered here rather than in print categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: A08 Brand Environment & Experience Design
rubrics_metrics.description: Work focused on the design, construction and personal experience of the brand story or message.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Submissions should demonstrate why the target audience found the experience remarkable, meaningful and memorable. May include retail environments, pop-up stores, exhibition stands or branded interiors, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: A09 Design-Driven Effectiveness
rubrics_metrics.description: Work that has produced measurable, tangible business results.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should detail how effectiveness was measured and evaluated and should demonstrate how the work was instrumental to cultural change or integral to achieving a brand’s purpose.

rubrics_metrics.name: A10 Brand Collateral
rubrics_metrics.description: Collection of media used to promote the brand and support the sales and marketing of a product or service.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This could include, but not be limited to, press/media kits, games, branded stationery, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: A11 Special Editions & Bespoke Items
rubrics_metrics.description: Domestic consumer objects and products that are produced in a low-volume series, as well as bespoke, one-off items.

rubrics_metrics.name: A12 Social Media Design
rubrics_metrics.description: The execution of design with the intention of increasing engagement through social media platforms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This may include content designed for Facebook, Instagram, X, Snapchat, TikTok and other social media platforms; focus on engagement metrics and platform-appropriate execution.

rubrics_metrics.name: A13 Posters
rubrics_metrics.description: Poster design for the use of promotion and brand communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Poster campaigns of more than two executions should be entered together as a single entry. Concepts developed for another medium and applied to a poster format are not eligible in this category.

rubrics_metrics.name: A14 Promotional Items / Promotional Printed Media
rubrics_metrics.description: Promotional printed media and items used for promotion and brand communication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This could include calendars, invitations, postcards, tickets and seasonal greeting cards, clothing, promotional gifts and samples, etc.

rubrics_metrics.name: A15 IP-Led Brand Identity & Storytelling (NEW)
rubrics_metrics.description: Work that uses intellectual property (IP) to create distinctive brand identities and compelling narratives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This could include strategic use of trademarks, copyrights, patents, characters, or proprietary designs to enhance storytelling, drive audience engagement, and establish cultural resonance.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Transformative Design — overarching expectation
rubrics_metrics.description: Transformational design focusing on innovative, impactful, and forward-thinking work that goes beyond traditional approaches to create meaningful change.

rubrics_metrics.name: B01 Inclusive Design
rubrics_metrics.description: Design work that prioritises inclusivity, ensuring accessibility and engagement for a diverse audience.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate a deep understanding of inclusive design principles, embracing diverse perspectives and needs, including those of individuals with disabilities, underrepresented communities, and varying socio-cultural backgrounds.

rubrics_metrics.name: B02 Sustainability-Focused Design
rubrics_metrics.description: Design work that champions sustainability through innovative design and messaging.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate a clear commitment to environmental stewardship, ethical practices, and social responsibility, integrating these values into the core of the work.

rubrics_metrics.name: B03 Innovation in Design
rubrics_metrics.description: Groundbreaking or experimental design that pushes the boundaries of traditional design work.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work utilising new technologies, mediums or creative approaches that materially advance design practice is appropriate here.

rubrics_metrics.name: B04 Use of Emerging Technology
rubrics_metrics.description: Recognises the integration of cutting-edge technologies, such as AI, AR/VR, etc, to create innovative and transformative design experiences.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Demonstrate how the chosen technologies materially contributed to the experience or solution.

rubrics_metrics.name: B05 Design for Behavioural Change
rubrics_metrics.description: Design solutions that successfully influence and inspire positive behavioural change.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate how design, through visual communication, user experience, or product innovation, has been strategically used to alter habits, attitudes, or actions toward a desired outcome—whether social, safety, or health-related.

rubrics_metrics.name: B06 Brand Transformation
rubrics_metrics.description: Exceptional design work that has played a pivotal role in transforming a brand’s identity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The work should demonstrate how design-led thinking has been strategically used to revitalise or reinvent a brand, whether through a complete rebrand, a visual refresh, or a shift in communication style.

rubrics_metrics.name: B07 AI Craft (NEW)
rubrics_metrics.description: Celebrating design work that could only exist because of AI.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design work should push beyond conventional creative limitations to achieve outcomes, experiences, or innovations that would be fundamentally unattainable through traditional methods alone.
